subject.subject_note: Release of the tracer-liveness fix. waitpid(-1, __WALL) let any child of the process be reaped by whichever tracer thread called it, so two concurrent sessions could steal each other's tracee and wedge a session at status 'running' with an empty log forever. Fixed with __WALL | __WNOTHREAD. Verified on release SHA aac09659 and published as annotated tag v0.9.0.

open_findings.summary: probe_drain still returns the hardcoded literal '"status": "running"' at crates/chronos-mcp/src/server.rs:2794, so the API cannot distinguish a dead worker from a healthy one. The empty state is byte-identical whether the producer never started, died, parked or is simply idle.
open_findings.closing_condition: Surface real worker liveness from the backend AtomicBool that no one currently reads.

open_findings.summary: uat_c2_01's three panic! paths do not tear down the probe session, because Drop cannot await probe_stop.
open_findings.closing_condition: Restructure the test so teardown is awaited on every exit path.

limits_of_this_verification: The tracer race is scheduler-dependent and was not reproduced on demand, so there is no controlled before/after measurement of it. Its occurrence rests on two independent reproductions of the same signature: the independent verifier at first_event_after_ms=300047, and CI on 684b3d16 with the control capture seeing an event at 5ms.

The first local verification-report draft described the pipelinek run as 'including test-workspace-integration'. Reading the run events showed that stage echoed 'TIER 2 NO EJECUTADO' and executed no integration test, so the claim was corrected before the report was stored.
verdict_note: This project's artifact schema accepts only PASS/FAIL/PARTIAL. The SDDK-native verdict is PASS_WITH_WARNINGS, recorded in verdict_native.
